notes: SCOPE AND LIMITS. This screen was built from 22 completed WebSearch (extended) queries; the session-wide web-search budget (200/200) was exhausted before the second pass, and direct HTTP/WebFetch to every financial host is blocked by the network policy, so no further verification was possible. RESULT: full price + FY2026 + FY2027 consensus sheets exist for 8 names (TSMC [FY2027 only in USD/ADR], MediaTek [FY2027 broker-level], Hon Hai, Delta, Wiwynn, Quanta, SK hynix, Samsung); 9 further names carry a sourced price only and are explicitly marked DATA INCOMPLETE for the central model to fill (AVC, ASE, Chroma, Unimicron, Elite Material, Hyundai Rotem, Samsung Biologics, Alteogen, ISU Petasys). All FY2025 actuals, LTG, market caps, 52-week ranges, price targets, dividends, betas and Zacks Ranks are null - none were retrieved. EPS BASIS: Taiwan and Korea consensus is IFRS/K-IFRS reported EPS (no non-GAAP series exists for these listings); ADR-level Zacks non-GAAP consensus exists only for TSM and ASX and was not retrieved. DATA-QUALITY FLAGS: (1) Wiwynn price 2,090 TWD vs FY2026 EPS 345.94 implies a 6x P/E, implausible for the sector - treat the pair as suspect until re-sourced from one provider. (2) MediaTek FY2027 (122.72) and FY2028 (406.51) are single-broker estimates, not consensus. (3) TSMC FY2027 is an ADR figure (USD 21.93 per ADR, 1 ADR = 5 shares) and FX was not sourced; FY2025 base is implied by the sourced +62.79% growth, not sourced directly. (4) Quanta 339 TWD is an early-session 30-Sep quote, not the confirmed close; ASE/Unimicron/EMC prices are 24-Sep closes; HPSP is 23-Sep. (5) Coupang at USD 13.88 looks far below its 2025 range - verify. (6) Two aggregator snapshots disagree for SK hynix, Samsung, MediaTek and Hon Hai; the Yahoo (most recent) figures were retained and the alternatives are listed in the labels. INDICATIVE PEG N+1 (P/E on FY2027 / growth FY2027 vs FY2026, growth capped at 50): Hon Hai 0.54, Delta 0.59, Quanta 0.76, MediaTek 0.80 (broker EPS), Wiwynn 0.12 (suspect), SK hynix 0.11 and Samsung 0.27 (cyclicals - no PEG per Lynch), TSMC n/a (FY2027 TWD missing; PEG on FY2026 growth about 0.46). INDEPENDENCE WARNING: every Taiwan AI name here (TSMC, Hon Hai, Quanta, Wiwynn, AVC, EMC, Unimicron, ASE, Chroma) and both memory makers share Nvidia/hyperscaler capex as the single growth driver; Delta is partly diversified (industrial/EV); only Hyundai Rotem, Samsung Biologics and Alteogen (and the excluded Hanwha Aerospace / HD Hyundai Electric) offer drivers independent from US AI, and none of those has EPS data yet. Markets: TAIEX closed 47,940 (+0.7%) on 30 Sep 2026 after an intraday record of 48,380 (Instaforex/Focus Taiwan).
